name: ember-foundation-substrate
description: Ember Foundation Substrate's idea-evaluation pipeline for Claude Code: chained virtual teams that take a product idea from question (team-research) to verdict (team-viability) to plan (team-business-plan).

plugins.name: ember-foundation-substrate-toolkit
plugins.description: Three chained virtual teams that take a product idea from question to plan: team-research (sourced market/competitor/monetization dossier), team-viability (BUILD / DON'T BUILD / NEEDS MORE EVIDENCE verdict, grounded in the real artifact plus the dossier), and team-business-plan (offering, financials, and go-to-market built on the verdict).

plugins.name: corpus-pattern-pipeline
plugins.description: Two chained pipelines that turn a large body of private source material into a validated, sourced, publication-ready document: corpus-mining (per-source extraction → cross-source pattern candidates → adversarial evaluation) and document-assembly (strip internal tracking artifacts, sanitize private references, developmental + line edit, render, proofread).
